name: gitlab-mcp
description: GitLab MCP server for projects, merge requests, issues, pipelines, wiki, releases, and more
long_description: Connects Claude to GitLab.com or a self-managed GitLab instance with a Personal Access Token. Covers projects, repositories, merge requests, issues, pipelines, wiki, releases, and more. Use the permission mode and toolset settings to limit which tools are exposed.

gitlab_personal_access_token.title: GitLab Personal Access Token
gitlab_personal_access_token.description: Personal Access Token with the api scope (read_api is enough with Permission Mode readonly).

gitlab_api_url.title: GitLab API URL
gitlab_api_url.description: GitLab API base URL. Change this for self-managed GitLab (e.g. https://gitlab.example.com/api/v4).

gitlab_permission_mode.title: Permission Mode
gitlab_permission_mode.description: Which tools are exposed: readonly (read-only tools only), modify (no delete/teardown tools), or full (all tools).

gitlab_toolsets.title: Toolsets
gitlab_toolsets.description: Optional comma-separated toolsets to enable (e.g. merge_requests,issues,pipelines, or all). Leave empty for the lean core toolset plus discover_tools.

gitlab_masking_enabled.title: Mask Sensitive Values
gitlab_masking_enabled.description: Mask GitLab tokens and IP addresses in tool responses.
